window.command: ZCODE_HOME=<folded snapshot copy of ~/.zcode> ccusage zcode daily -j -O -z UTC
window.note: ccusage is pointed at a rollback-mode COPY of the live WAL store, never at ~/.zcode itself (§18 row 7: a read-only attach against a WAL store creates or rewrites someone else's -wal/-shm). `-O` keeps the offline price table. The window stops on the last day the store contains: ZCode's tables are append-only, so a pinned window stays comparable while the corpus grows, which is what makes it usable as a regression gate. ZCode is unpriced in both tools, so totalCost is 0 by plan billing, not by measurement.

equivalences: ccusage.totalTokens == SUM(computed_total_tokens) == SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens), and 1395/1395 rows satisfy computed_total == input+output
the store's rows are 1:1 with logical_request_id (1395 rows, 1395 distinct), so per_record_sum and request_max agree
the headline INCLUDES the 367 subagent rows (15,657,611 tokens) — hence aggregation.subagentsIncluded = true; excluding them reads -9.3%
